_about: The ONE copy of the EWP script field order. Read by scripts/format-ewp-scripts.mjs. Other files point here and do not copy it.
_why: This is a personal authoring convention. It is not an EWP rule. YAML key order never changes how a script runs. The goal is that every script example we write looks the same.
_howToEdit: Each inner list is one slot. Names in the same slot are aliases, and their order in the script does not matter. Earlier slot = earlier in the script. A field that is not listed here stays where it is. If a new field needs a place, ask the user, then add it here.
_nestedAbout: Applies inside a list item that sits under one of the keys in nestedListKeys.
